description: This PHP class 'ConvertOctal' provides methods to convert octal numbers to binary, decimal, and hexadecimal formats, including validation and error handling, within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library.

classes.name: ConvertOctal
classes.description: A class for converting octal numbers to binary, decimal, and hexadecimal formats with validation and error handling.

methods.name: toBinary
methods.description: Converts an octal value to binary, with optional padding, handling array inputs and errors.

methods.name: toDecimal
methods.description: Converts an octal value to decimal, handling two's complement for negative numbers.

methods.name: toHex
methods.description: Converts an octal value to hexadecimal, with optional padding, handling array inputs and errors.

methods.name: validateOctal
methods.description: Validates that a string is a proper octal number with up to 10 digits.
